title: This ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Nerf Collab Reimagines HUNTR/X’s Demon-Fighting Weapons in Foam Form
summary: Rumi, Mira and Zoey's swords and spirit blades are now soft and safe for at-home play.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

The KPop Demon Hunters merch juggernaut shows no signs of slowing down, with a new Nerf collaboration that reimagines HUNTR/X’s demon-fighting weapons of choice for (gentle) at-home roleplay.

First announced in January, the Nerf KPop Demon Hunters collection hits retailers this month, and is one of the latest toy releases celebrating the Oscar-winning animated film . The officially licensed collaboration captures the look and colors of the HUNTR/X characters’ weaponry, reimagined in Nerf’s signature soft, foam construction.

FOAM SWORD

Nerf x 'KPop Demon Hunters' Rumi's Four Tiger Sword

$14.97

Buy Now at walmart

The 24-inch foam replica recreates Rumi’s signature Four Tiger Sword from the film with a pearlescent blade, plastic core and molded plastic hilt.

Sized for cosplay, it’s lightweight while maintaining the character’s distinctive design. Recommended for ages 6 and up, it can also be paired with the rest of the Nerf KPop Demon Hunters weapon collection for a great trio Halloween costume or at-home roleplay.

FOAM BLADES

Nerf x 'KPop Demon Hunters' Zoey's Spirit Blades

$10.19

This set includes three, eight-inch foam Spirit Blades modeled after Zoey’s signature throwing weapons from the movie.

Each blade features a pearlescent finish and lightweight foam construction designed for imaginative play or cosplay. The set re-creates the look of Zoey’s onscreen accessories and is compatible with the broader KPop Demon Hunters roleplay collection.

FOAM CURVED MOON SWORD

Nerf x 'KPop Demon Hunters' Mira's Curved Moon Sword

$19.97

Mira’s signature Curved Moon Sword measures 36 inches once assembled.

Inspired by the weapon used by the film’s lead dancer and choreographer, the Moon Sword adds an exciting touch to your next KPop Demon Hunters ‘ dance routine or performance, with an accessory that won’t poke your eyes out while you’re busting your big moves, thanks to a gentle and flexible foam blade. The blade features a pearlescent blue finish, and sits on a plastic hilt.

These are all officially licensed KPop Demon Hunters toy releases from Netflix and Hasbro. The toymaker says the trio of Nerf weapons “is expanding the fandom experience,” calling them the “perfect accessories for role play, cosplay, and epic demon-hunting adventures.”

The Nerf collection comes on the heels of other recent merch releases inspired by the hit film, including official concert light sticks , “ramen”-style blind boxes and Furby electronic plush dolls .
